newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikon 1997/98 profit seen falling 12 pct - paper.
newsitem.headline: Nikon 1997/98 profit seen falling 12 pct - paper.

text.p: Nikon Corp's parent current profit is expected to fall 12 percent year-on-year to about 15 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1998, due to an expected fall in sales of microchip-producing machines, a Japanese business daily said on Thursday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Nikon's 1996/97 parent current profit would be about 17 billion yen against an actual 18.85 billion last fiscal year.

It said Nikon's sales of steppers for semiconductor making fell in the second half of 1996/97 because of cuts in capital investment by microchip makers and the sluggishness was expected to continue through 1997/98.
Nikon was not immediately available for comment on the report.
